patch.value: Decision: analytics operate on STRUCTURAL edges only

Analytics (cycles/path/critical-path/analyze) operate ONLY on STRUCTURAL edges: BLOCKED_BY + CHILD_OF + dependency edges (BLOCKS/RELATED/etc.). Facet edges (HAS_TYPE/HAS_STATUS/ASSIGNED_TO/IN_SPRINT/IN_RELEASE) and tag edges (TAGGED_WITH) are deliberately excluded. Rationale: if facet/tag edges were included, every item sharing a status or tag would appear linked, producing meaningless cycles, inflated centrality, a single giant connected component, and bogus 'paths'. Filtering to structural edges keeps cycle/path/critical-path semantically honest. Implemented via isStructuralEdge() reusing the existing FACET_REL_TYPES/TAG_REL_TYPE classification, and structuralEdges() additionally restricts endpoints to PmItem nodes only (facet/external nodes dropped).

Filtering to structural edges keeps cycle/path/critical-path semantically honest. Implemented via isStructuralEdge() reusing the existing FACET_REL_TYPES/TAG_REL_TYPE classification, and structuralEdges() additionally restricts endpoints to PmItem nodes only (facet/external nodes dropped).

Edge direction note: BLOCKED_BY is stored item->blocker (B --BLOCKED_BY--> A means B is blocked by A). Therefore a 'root' (no incoming dep edge) is the most-blocked item and a 'leaf' (no outgoing dep edge) is a foundational item. critical-path / longestChain follow these directed edges; verified against a planted A<-B<-C<-D chain (length 4).
Decision recorded; implemented and verified with real data.
